scope: Blind independent correspondence review of every canonical indicator family against the frozen local T0 input inventory.
blindness: Do not view primary-AI or H2 correspondence files or decisions.
Do not view candidate dimensions, final indicators, feature counts, targets, model outcomes, or prediction performance.
Do not use v2 final selection decisions; v2 may not determine a match.
Do not use Qwen, Ollama, repository model runners, or local/external LLM APIs.
instructions: Review every row and preserve protected evidence, row order, and reviewer_role=H1.
Names alone never establish equivalence. Compare object, formula/algorithm, unit, T0 boundary, required inputs, and construct role.
Use exact_materialized only for an identical frozen value and exact_derivable only for a fully deterministic identical derivation.
Use candidate_formula_completion when the inventory may support the family but exact literature definition must first be recovered from English primary/foundational full text.
Use construct_mismatch for a different graph, population, aggregation level, statistic, window, or causal role even if labels overlap.
For positive or completion-candidate rows, provide exact inventory source IDs, source_id:column values, derivation, equivalence notes, and a reason.
Provide a reason for every negative row; do not leave any family undecided.
